scientific_limitations: This is an exact finite classification for four rows, ternary alphabet, and strength three. It does not extend automatically to larger alphabets or row counts. The principal originality risk is an older small-parameter design classification indexed under orthogonal arrays or affine planes rather than perfect hash families.
title: Maximum four-row ternary perfect hash families form one affine-plane class
